{{Top|leg}}
'''Rysais''' was a popular [[Grain/Legends|grain]] on [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]], that was essential for the colony. The [[Rysais Producers Co-operative]] grew huge fields of rysais south of [[Tal'cara]] to feed Kothlis inhabitants.
